svg.title: Cool the stopped sample without any precursor flux
svg.desc: Cooling without flux is explicitly used for these stopped catalyst TEM-composition specimens. It is not asserted as a universal cool-down for all optical or grown nanowires. Cooling time/rate and numerical UHV pressure are unreported. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.

g.text: Cool the stopped sample without any precursor flux
